pages.bodyHtml:
Return Policy for Trumee

At Trumee, we value your satisfaction and strive to provide the best shopping experience. If you’re not completely satisfied with your purchase, we’re here to help. Below are the details of our return policy for your convenience.

Eligibility for Returns

  1. Time Frame: Items are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery. Returns initiated beyond this period will not be accepted.
  2. Condition of the Item: To be eligible for a return, the product must:
    • Be unused, unwashed, and unworn.
    • Have all original tags, labels, and packaging intact.
    • Be free from stains, marks, damages, or odors (e.g., perfume, deodorant).
  3. Exceptions:
    • Items marked as “Final Sale” or “Non-Returnable” are not eligible for returns.
    • Accessories or promotional gifts received with the purchase must also be returned if applicable.
    • Items with customization or alterations (e.g., personalized fittings) are not eligible for returns.

Steps to Initiate a Return

  1. Request a Return:
    • Visit our website and navigate to the “Returns” section.
    • Fill out the Return Request Form with your order details, reason for return, and item(s) you wish to return.
  2. Approval of Return:
    • Once your request is reviewed, you will receive a confirmation email with instructions for returning the product.
    • Approval may take up to 48 hours after submission.
  3. Return Shipping:
    • Pack the product securely in its original packaging.
    • Ship it to the address mentioned in the approval email using a reliable courier service.
    • Customers are responsible for return shipping costs unless the return is due to an error on our part (e.g., wrong product, damaged item).

Refund Process

  1. Modes of Refund:
    • Refunds will be processed in the original payment method (e.g., credit card, UPI, etc.) based on customer preference.
    • For orders placed through Cash on Delivery (COD), refunds are processed via bank transfer or UPI within 7 to 10 working days after the returned product successfully passes the quality check at our warehouse. At the time of approving your return request, we will collect your bank account details or UPI ID to facilitate the refund process. Please note that cash refunds are not available under any circumstances.
  2. Refund Timeline:
    • Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of the refund.
    • Approved refunds will be credited within 7-10 business days.
  3. Deductions:
    • If applicable, shipping costs or processing fees may be deducted from the refund amount.

Exchange Policy

  1. Exchanges are subject to availability of the requested size, color, or item.
  2. Customers must initiate an exchange request via the “Returns” section on the website.
  3. Once the original item is received and inspected, the replacement of the item will be done within 3-5 business days.

Damaged or Incorrect Items

  1. If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, please:
    • Notify us within 48 hours of delivery via email or phone.
    • Attach clear photographs of the issue along with your order details.
  2. We will arrange a free return pickup for such cases and issue a full refund.

Important Notes

  • Non-Compliance: Items that do not meet the above conditions will not be accepted for return or refund.
  • Communication: Please ensure that all communication regarding returns is made through the official channels listed on our website.
  • Right to Refuse: Trumee reserves the right to refuse returns that do not comply with the stated policy.

For any assistance or queries, please feel free to contact our Customer Care team:

  • Email: contact@trumee.in
  • Phone: +91 99869 50695 (10 AM – 7 PM, Mon-Sat)

Thank you for choosing Trumee. We look forward to serving you!

posts.title: The Ultimate Trumee Style Guide: Lookbook for Every Occasion
posts.author: Team Trumee
posts.bodyHtml:
When it comes to effortless western wear, Trumee brings a perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and wanderlust-inspired designs. Whether you’re off to a tropical getaway, brunching with friends, or planning a romantic dinner, our new collection has something for every occasion.

From breezy vacation-ready dresses to chic co-ord sets and statement tops, this lookbook breaks down how to style our latest pieces to create effortlessly stylish outfits.

1. Breezy Vacation Looks: Chic & Comfortable

Nothing says vacation-ready like flowy silhouettes, vibrant prints, and relaxed fits. Here are some of our best picks for travel-friendly, fuss-free styling.

🌿 Look 1: The Bohemian Handkerchief Hem Dress (TRMD04)

  • Why We Love It: The flowy, A-line silhouette and intricate boho prints make this a dreamy choice for tropical vacations and resort getaways.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Strappy flat sandals for a casual beach vibe
    ✅ Bold earrings and a straw hat for the perfect summer look
    ✅ Layer a crochet shrug for breezy evenings

🌊 Look 2: The Elegant Halter Midi Dress (TRMD02)

  • Why We Love It: The floral and paisley printed georgette dress comes with a fitted bodice and a tiered skirt, perfect for evening getaways.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Strappy heels and a clutch for a dinner by the sea
    ✅ Minimalist gold jewelry for a polished, elegant finish
    ✅ A woven tote bag for daytime charm

☀️ Look 3: The Mustard Artistic Print Co-ord Set (TRMCS01)

  • Why We Love It: This abstract print set is ideal for vacations, offering a chic yet relaxed fit with its crochet lace detailing.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ White sneakers or chunky sandals for a laid-back street-style vibe
    ✅ A structured tote bag to add an element of sophistication
    ✅ Dainty layered necklaces for subtle accessorizing

2. Brunch-Ready Chic: Playful & Feminine

For weekend brunches or daytime gatherings, these breezy yet polished outfits will keep you looking effortlessly chic.

🍓 Look 4: The Sunny Daisy Swiss Dot Wrap Dress (TRMD10)

  • Why We Love It: The floral daisy print on Swiss dot fabric brings lightweight elegance and playfulness to brunch dressing.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ White sneakers for a casual-cool look
    ✅ Nude block heels for a slightly elevated feel
    ✅ A woven crossbody bag and gold hoop earrings for extra charm

🍊 Look 5: The Rust Check Sleeveless Cotton Dress (TRMD03)

  • Why We Love It: Featuring a flattering scoop neckline, functional side pockets, and delicate floral embroidery, this button-down dress offers a chic casual aesthetic.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Tan ankle boots for a trendy, city-girl vibe
    ✅ A brown crossbody bag for a rustic-chic look
    ✅ Layer with a denim jacket for cooler evenings

🍷 Look 6: The Paisley Print Cotton Moss Boho Dress (TRMD06)

  • Why We Love It: A lace-up neckline, flared sleeves, and a tiered hemline make this boho dress a brunch-time staple.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Flat sandals for a relaxed vibe
    ✅ Chunky rings and tassel earrings for a bold touch
    ✅ A beaded clutch for a statement look

3. Effortlessly Glam: Evening Elegance

For date nights, cocktail parties, or semi-formal gatherings, opt for flattering silhouettes, lace details, and rich hues.

🌹 Look 7: The Monochrome Floral Printed Wrap Dress (TRMD11)

  • Why We Love It: A deep V-neckline, a wrap-style silhouette, and a unique mix of prints make this dress flattering and sophisticated.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Strappy black heels for a refined finish
    ✅ A sleek ponytail and statement earrings
    ✅ A structured clutch for extra elegance

🍷 Look 8: The Mustard Crochet Bodice & Floral Georgette Skirt Dress (TRMD05)

  • Why We Love It: The contrast between the structured crochet bodice and the flowy floral skirt makes this boho-chic yet refined.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ Black ankle boots for a stylish twist
    ✅ A leather sling bag for a semi-formal look
    ✅ A bold red lip to elevate the ensemble

4. Trendy & Versatile: Everyday Staples

For work-to-weekend or chic everyday dressing, opt for peplum tops, structured jumpsuits, and flirty skirts.

💫 Look 9: The Ombre Cotton Schiffli Dungaree-Style Jumpsuit (TRMJS01)

  • Why We Love It: The ombre effect and delicate schiffli embroidery make this jumpsuit a comfortable yet stylish all-day outfit.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ White sneakers for casual elegance
    ✅ Layer with a crop top underneath for a fresh twist
    ✅ Statement earrings to add a pop of color

🖤 Look 10: The Black Textured Georgette Peplum Top (TRMT02)

  • Why We Love It: Featuring floral texture and a cinched waistline, this peplum top is perfect for pairing with jeans, skirts, or tailored pants.
  • Style It With:
    ✅ High-waisted jeans and ankle boots for a city-chic look
    ✅ Layer with a blazer for a work-ready transition
    ✅ Add bold earrings for a touch of glam

Final Thoughts: Elevate Your Everyday with Trumee

At Trumee, we believe that fashion should be fun, versatile, and effortless. Whether you’re styling for vacations, brunches, evenings out, or casual outings, our collection has something that fits every mood and occasion.

💌 We’d love to see how you style your favorite Trumee outfits! Share your looks on Instagram with #StyledByTrumee for a chance to be featured on our page!
